system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: templates/logging_sink.jinja

resources:
  - name: log-analytics-dataset
    type: bigquery.v2.dataset
    properties:
      datasetReference:
        datasetId: log_analytics_dataset
        projectId: $(ref.project.projectId)
      location: US
      description: "Long-term log analytics dataset for Cloud Logging export"
      defaultTableExpirationMs: 31536000000
      defaultPartitionExpirationMs: 31536000000
      labels:
        environment: production
        purpose: log-analytics
        managed-by: deployment-manager
      access:
        - role: OWNER
          specialGroup: projectOwners
        - role: READER
          specialGroup: projectReaders
        - role: WRITER
          specialGroup: projectWriters

  - name: project-log-sink
    type: gcp-types/logging-v2:projects.sinks
    properties:
      sink: project-bigquery-log-sink
      parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]
      uniqueWriterIdentity: true
      destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_ID]/datasets/$(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
      description: "Exports all project logs to BigQuery for long-term analysis and compliance"
      filter: |
        severity >= DEFAULT
        AND NOT protoPayload.serviceName="logging.googleapis.com"
      bigqueryOptions:
        usePartitionedTables: true
      exclusions:
        - name: exclude-healthchecks
          description: "Exclude noisy load balancer health check logs"
          filter: 'resource.type="http_load_balancer" AND httpRequest.userAgent=~"GoogleHC"'
          disabled: false
        - name: exclude-debug
          description: "Exclude debug-level logs to reduce cost"
          filter: 'severity=DEBUG'
          disabled: false
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - log-analytics-dataset

  - name: sink-writer-bigquery-binding
    action: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:bigquery.datasets.patch
    properties:
      projectId: [PROJECT_ID]
      datasetId: $(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
      access:
        - role: OWNER
          specialGroup: projectOwners
        - role: READER
          specialGroup: projectReaders
        - role: WRITER
          specialGroup: projectWriters
        - role: WRITER
          userByEmail: $(ref.project-log-sink.writerIdentity)
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - project-log-sink

outputs:
  - name: sinkName
    value: $(ref.project-log-sink.name)
  - name: sinkWriterIdentity
    value: $(ref.project-log-sink.writerIdentity)
  - name: sinkDestination
    value: $(ref.project-log-sink.destination)
  - name: bigqueryDatasetId
    value: $(ref.log-analytics-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
